description: Resolve a user's country and document into the slug the other tools take. Pass the words the user used ('India passport', 'Schengen visa', 'UK passport digital', '2x2'). Returns JSON text with up to 5 matches, each with 'slug' (use it for get_photo_spec and get_make_link), the country, the document family, the title and a 'url' to cite, plus an 'attribution' line to quote with the answer.

country.description: Optional country name, alias, ISO code or slug to restrict the matches to one country, e.g. 'India', 'UK', 'us'.

locale.description: Language of the prose fields (title, summary, rules). One of: en, es, fr, de, pt, hi, ar, zh, ru, vi, tr, id, ja. Default 'en'. Official quotes and every number are identical in all languages.

query.description: The user's words for the document, usually country plus document type, e.g. 'Canada passport' or 'US visa'.

name: find_document
title: Find a passport, visa or ID photo document
